purpose: Human-readable benchmark manifest; not a resolver-generated dependency lock.
dependency_lock: See uv.lock for the Python 3.12 dependency resolution. TensorRT 10.3.0 nested NVIDIA binary downloads are not fully resolved or hashed by this lock.

cuda.driver: record actual nvidia-smi driver in result environment

gpu: NVIDIA GPU required for TensorRT/Triton measurements; record model, compute capability, and memory_bytes
plan_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m inferbench.cli triton-repo --platform tensorrt_plan --plan artifacts/engines/resnet18-fp16-b32.plan --out model_repository
notes: Benchmark results preserve raw timing samples in seconds.
Unavailable backends are skipped with a reason; no timing is estimated.
This manifest pins software but does not replace host driver and GPU prerequisites.
Energy is read from the NVML cumulative GPU-board counter; unsupported counters remain unavailable, and board readings include unrelated GPU activity.
CPU/host energy is not measured. Remote Triton energy is not attributed to the client GPU.
Cache benchmarks should record unique inputs for miss workloads or repeat inputs for hot-cache workloads; hit/miss metrics are not yet scraped by the harness.
The pinned TensorRT 10.3.0 PyPI source metadata describes this release as intended for TensorRT-LLM; GPU package installation and compatibility have not been verified.
